handoff.salientSummary: Finished the remaining items of messages-and-waitlist-ui on top of e5c6e296: server-driven swap/move/overbook on floor drop and the waitlist Seat dialog, Sites time-zone notes, a shared-schema contract test, a Playwright spec, Arabic strings, and live browser checks on acme and riyadh-grill. Lint, typecheck, Vitest, Lingui and the new Playwright spec pass. Committed as 5e7c5b12.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: (6) Floor-plan drop and the waitlist Seat dialog now ask the server first and read the 409 table_occupied conflict (occupant, resolutions). The new WaitlistSeatPrompt names the occupant and offers Swap, Move or Overbook; the Seat dialog also gets swap/move buttons. (4) Sites notify-me form and waitlist join box show the restaurant time-zone note when the visitor's zone differs. (7) App was already on the @repo/reservations waitlist schemas; Sites gets the @repo/reservations devDependency and a contract test of join, notify-me and status bodies against the shared schemas. (1) New Playwright spec covering message settings save, waitlist notify and swap, waitlist settings, and floor synthetic-DragEvent drop with an RTL check. (5) Arabic strings for all new text, and the waitlist screen was checked in Arabic RTL. (2) KSA org checks and (3) real-browser Sites notify-me were done (see verification).

discoveredIssues.description: turbo run typecheck --filter=app runs out of memory at the default Node heap (exit 134) when other dev services are running. tsc passes with --max-old-space-size=6144.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 in the typecheck service command.

discoveredIssues.description: The Sites availability endpoint rate-limits after about 30 requests per minute per client, so scripted scans for a full day return 'Too many attempts'.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Validators should space requests out, or use a temporary rsv_pacing_rules row (max_covers=1) in the acme tenant DB to force a 'full' day and remove it afterwards.
